decisions.reason: The source Event relaxes prototype dimensions for the main board; it does not change the power board's established orientation, size goals, aspect ratio, or mounting constraints.
Main-board dimensional flexibility does not alter the interboard connector types, pinouts, matching policy, power chain, or signal interface.

Dimensional flexibility does not remove or modify the connector-alignment and cable-routing rules. This Requirement already has a separate same-message MODIFY for the source's top-versus-side connector-placement clause.
Allowing main-board dimensions to change for the prototype does not change the four-board topology or the identities of the separate boards.

The main-board dimension decision does not change the power-board battery connector placement, orientation, accessibility, or mounting-hole clearance. The separate connector-access clause from the same message is already represented.
Prototype board dimensions do not alter DCDC1 voltage, current rating, compensation, or rail-regulation behavior.
Main-board dimensional flexibility does not change the monitored rails, INA3221 selection, monitor placement, measurement coverage, or spare channel.
The source decision concerns prototype dimensions and does not change standalone USB power activation, regulation, source selection, or powered loads.
The source identifies the three enclosure boards and relaxes main-board dimensions; it does not change the separate LED daughterboard's form, LED count, or selected component.
Changing allowable main-board dimensions does not modify the required panel-button connector, its main-board location, PWRON connection, or control behavior.
Prototype dimensional flexibility does not change the sensor board's fanout role, interboard inputs, external-module connectors, or connector count.
The source decision does not alter the charge-status display method, external charge-LED interface, resistor values, or component population requirements.
